messages.subject: Inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed
parts:
Hi all

I am new to inla and encountered this problem. I have areal data of 581 observations and I want to run this model :

formula20tot <- SUM_2020 ~ f(idarea, model = "bym2", graph = g20)
res20tot <- inla(formula20tot,family = "poisson", data = map20@data,
                 E = E20tot, control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
                 verbose=TRUE)

There is no 0 value in SUM_2020, Etot ranged from 0.2 to 1660. When I tried to run the model it crashed and I received error message as attached.

Rare enough that yesterday I ran the same model and it worked just fine.

I am working with windows, memory 32GB (I hope it's not a memory issue).

Can anybody help me with this problem?

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed
parts:
It runs into a numerical singularity. Its unclear why this is the case. 
It looks like phi->1 (see inla.doc(“bym2”)), hence this model will reduce to model=“besag”.

If you want me to check closer, I need code and data to rerun it here.

thx
H

--
